    Alle Klassen und Schnittstellen

    Klasse
    Beschreibung
    Colors
    A centralized collection of predefined, application-specific Color constants for consistent and semantic visual styling across the plot framework.
    ControlBuilder<T>
    Builder class for plot control panels.
    CustomDrawable
    Defines the contract for objects that can be drawn on a graphics context.
    DrawableObject
    An abstract base class for drawable objects that provides common rendering infrastructure.
    DrawablePanel
    A custom JPanel that manages and renders a list of drawable objects.
    EmptyGrid
    A PlotGrid implementation that renders no visual grid lines or background elements.
    GridPosition
    Defines standardized positions for aligning the coordinate grid within a plot panel.
    Icon
    A centralized registry of application icons, providing static paths and a utility method to load images from embedded resources.
    LegendItem
    A small, visually styled panel that represents a single color entry in a plot legend.
    ModernButton
    A custom-styled, modern-looking button with rounded corners, dynamic color states, and precise hit detection.
    ModernCheckBox
    A visually enhanced checkbox component that integrates with the application's custom design system.
    ModernCheckBoxIcon
    A custom icon implementation for a modern, flat-style checkbox used in the ModernCheckBox component.
    ModernIconButton
    A modern-styled icon-only button that extends ModernButton.
    ModernLabeledBorder
    A custom Swing border that displays a title label above or alongside an optional rounded rectangle outline.
    ModernSlider
    A custom-styled slider component that replaces the default Swing appearance with a modern, minimalist design using the application's color scheme.
    PlotApplication
    The main application window that coordinates rendering and user interaction for multiple plot sets.
    PlotButtonPanel
    A panel containing navigation, zoom, control toggle, and status buttons for the plot application.
    PlotControl<T>
    An abstract base class for plot control windows that manage user interaction with a homogeneous list of plot graphs of the same concrete type.
    PlotGraph<T>
    An abstract base class for plot graphs that supports self-referential generics to enable type-safe interaction with associated plot controls.
    PlotGraphList<T>
    A type-safe list for storing plot graph instances of a specific concrete type.
    PlotGrid
    A drawable object that renders a simple coordinate grid consisting of horizontal and vertical axes centered in the panel, along with a label at the origin point (0,0).
    PlotInfoPanel
    A panel that displays user guidance and dynamic feedback for plot interaction.
    PlotSet<T>
    An abstract base class that groups a plot grid and a type-safe list of plot graphs of the same concrete type.
    RoundedLineBorder
    A custom Swing border that renders a rounded rectangle outline with configurable stroke thickness and corner curvature.
    SerialReader
    A utility class for reading numeric data from a serial port (e.g., an Arduino) and appending it to a shared list in real time.
    Sonifier
    A utility class that converts numeric data sequences into audible sound representations (sonification) and supports real-time playback or WAV file export.
    Stroke
    A collection of predefined BasicStroke instances for consistent and semantic line styling in plot rendering.
